name: Soundpays
description: Toronto company operating TAP, the Thought-to-Action Protocol, connecting user intent to near-instant actions.
notes: DMZ Alumni. HQ address from company site.
address: 383 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1S4

name: Souqh
description: Real estate and home services marketplace connecting homeowners with service providers.
notes: DMZ Alumni. Toronto-based per DMZ/CB Insights; founded year from CB Insights/Village.ai.

name: SpaceRyde
description: Canadian launch company that planned a balloon-launched small rocket for satellite delivery.
notes: YC W2019. Filed for bankruptcy around Feb 2023 (Payload); website domain no longer resolves; YC lists Inactive. Rocket factory was in Concord (Vaughan), ON.

name: Speedy Labs
description: AI agents that reconcile rebates and surface short pays for foodservice distributors.
notes: YC W23. HQ ambiguous: site footer lists San Francisco / Toronto; YC lists Toronto. Seed round data from Seedtable may be mixed with SpeedyBrand, treat with caution. Hiring flag carried from YC listing.

name: Spellbook
description: AI contract drafting, review and redlining platform for legal teams and law firms.
notes: Formerly Rally, rebranded 2023. Site has a /careers link. Founded year and headcount vary by directory.

name: Spiffy
description: Microlearning training platform and employee app for brands, retailers and employers.
notes: DMZ Alumni. Address from company site; no careers page found.
address: 151 Bloor St W, Suite 800, Toronto, ON M5S 1S4

name: SPOTWORK
description: On-demand hourly staffing marketplace for industrial labour in warehousing, logistics and manufacturing.
notes: HQ conflict: website footer shows a Dallas, TX address (US operations, 35+ US markets); directories (ZoomInfo etc.) and press release list Toronto (33 Bloor St E, not confirmed on company site). Kept as Toronto, low confidence. Address left null.

name: Sprintlio
description: Agile sprint retrospective tool for remote teams with Jira and Slack integrations.
notes: Toronto per G2/DMZ; founded 2018 per Capterra. Site is live (copyright 2023) but one comparison page claims the tool has been unavailable since April 2023; status unresolved. No careers page.

name: Spruce Software Inc. dba 409.AI
notes: HQ not confirmed in GTA: CB Insights lists Collingwood, ON (71 Dillon Dr); Clutch lists Columbus, OH primary with Toronto secondary. Company site gives no address. Sources: https://www.cbinsights.com/company/spruce-7, https://clutch.co/profile/409ai

name: SRTX
notes: HQ is Montreal, Quebec (YC listing, Wikipedia); founded in Muskoka, ON. Site srtxlabs.com does not resolve. Sources: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/srtx, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SRTX

name: Stage TEN
description: Platform for live, interactive, shoppable shows for creators.
notes: Domain stageten.tv no longer resolves (DNS failure), so marked closed; no shutdown article found. Toronto and 2014 founding per CB Insights.

name: Stempad
description: Collaborative online platform for writing and publishing science, with AI copilot.
notes: YC S24. HQ low confidence: YC lists Toronto, but founder Ralph Rouhana was a University of Waterloo student; no address on site. Stage Pre-seed is an assumption from YC-only funding; no round data found. Site has a Careers link but no listed roles.

name: Stone Paper
notes: DMZ Alumni, tagged LegalTech. Website threelefts.ca refused connection (appears dead). A Toronto app called StonePaper launched in beta in 2016 (Motherboard) but link to this entry (Three Lefts) is not confirmed.

name: StratumAI
description: Deep-tech AI for mining resource modelling and decision-making.
notes: YC W20. stratum.ai redirects to stratum.gs (new domain). Toronto per YC/CB Insights; no address on site. Careers page exists but lists no specific roles.

name: Structure Plus
description: Cloud-based structural engineering software for optimizing materials and generating detailing sheets.
notes: DMZ Alumni. Site footer lists Toronto, Canada; no address; no careers section.

name: Studeo
description: AI-driven interactive storytelling platform for real estate marketing (Storybooks).
notes: Toronto-based per search results (MaRS profile, press). Founded 2013 per press release (Latka says 2014). Site copyright 2026; no careers section.

name: Superbar
description: AI sales assistant and algorithmic product-discovery feed for ecommerce stores.
notes: YC S22, formerly Caddie. Toronto per YC/VCBacked (Shopify developer address in Richmond Hill, ON); open roles listed are New York/remote. HQ low confidence.

name: SuperCode
description: Coding education platform where students learn text-based code inside immersive 3D worlds.
notes: Operated by Creatubbles (Toronto, CB Insights lists 77 King St W, not verified on site). CEO Paul Greenberg per DMZ. Founded 2013 per CB Insights.

name: Sweat and Tonic
description: Toronto boutique fitness and wellness company with studios, a spa and a lounge.
notes: Boutique fitness operator, not a tech startup; kept because of its LinkedIn Top Startups ranking. Studios at 225 Yonge St and 486 Front St W (no HQ address stated). Founded 2017 by David Ingram per press; first studio 2019. Careers link goes to a talentnest board (roles not checked).

name: Swift Medical Inc.
description: AI-powered wound care technology for healthcare providers, payers and researchers.
notes: Toronto HQ per press releases. A further USD 8M round was announced Jan 2024 (round name not stated). Street address conflicts between sources (1 Richmond St W vs 1 King St W), left null. Headcount about 60 in June 2024; company now describes itself as remote-first.

name: Switchboard
description: SDK and no-code editor for building real-time audio and voice AI software, by Synervoz Communications.
notes: Operated by Synervoz Communications Inc., Toronto, founded 2014 per directory. DMZ tag said Logistics; reclassified from site content. No careers listing on site.

name: SWTCH
description: EV charging company with the SWTCH Cortex platform and turnkey charger installation and management.
notes: Careers page says headquartered in Toronto with offices in Boston and New York. Jobs hosted on Workable (apply.workable.com/swtch-energy), not checked for open roles.

name: Sync
description: Privacy-focused end-to-end encrypted cloud storage and file sharing.
notes: Founded 2011 per company site. Address from PitchBook/directories, not the company site. Careers page links to Indeed; open roles not confirmed.
address: 105-155 Gordon Baker Rd, Toronto, ON M2H 3N5

name: Taiga Robotics
description: Intelligent robotic palletizers with AI-assisted programming and digital-twin deployment.
notes: DMZ Alumni. Address from company site; no careers listing found.

name: Tailscale
description: Corporate VPN and secure networking software built on WireGuard.
notes: Toronto listed as primary HQ on LinkedIn and Built In; company is fully remote so no street address. Headcount ranges vary by source. Company site says it is hiring.
